title: SFT Protocol (Filecoin FEVM) — live extractability deep dive
closed_reasons: lending pool withdraw() reverts POOL_FIL_BALANCE_NOT_ENOUGH for every holder (withdrawals frozen; internal accounting gate; contract FIL balance irrelevant)
lending pool borrow() reverts NOT_PLEDGE_THIS_ORDER; pledge() reverts for arbitrary callers; utilization 99.99% > borrowThreshold 95%
reward pool batchClaim is per-user per-order credit accounting: fresh stake earns 0; cross-user claim reverts Panic(0x32); unstake of fresh orders reverts 'it is not time to unlock' (6-month lock)
reward pool deposit()/withdraw() revert for fresh callers
mint/withdraw pool deposit() reverts and pool holds 0 FIL
SFT mint gated ('Only minter can call'); SFT/rSFT/rSPD have no DEX market
key_facts: Lending pool 0x147122D1EBdA76E4910ccdC53aEb6a58605Eb58E holds 53.7862261354336 FIL; totalPooledFIL = rSFT totalSupply = 234477.718487329089234903 (rate exactly 1:1)
Reward pool 0xE86D3dBd8233F1BFA22679cB57FaB3428E9654f7 holds 1000.0751373305601 FIL + 854354.36103 staked SFT
Total live EVM-visible value 1054.23 FIL = $1156.49 at FIL $1.097 (CoinGecko 2026-10-15)
Fork test: fresh attacker gets $0 from every path; holder withdrawal reverts POOL_FIL_BALANCE_NOT_ENOUGH (last successful withdrawal block 5472905)
Fork test: existing credited stakers can still claim small FIL amounts from the reward pool (H-O): observed 1e-5, 9.96e-12, 3.79e-12 FIL
Storage bisection: withdrawal freeze is gated by pool storage slot 2 (=185868.916202 FIL internal accounting), not by the contract's FIL balance
Only 1 borrow ever succeeded on the lending pool (block 4512413, 0.11 FIL); 4 later attempts reverted
SFT token 0xC5eA96Dd365983cfEc90E72b6A2daC9562f458Ba: supply 1388939.198, mint minter-gated, no market price/volume
ProxyAdmin 0x98002559DC58B1c1ba01f6c5F309a9e92af589DD owner = EOA 0x0E294a09Ab6d03597A79e52c951410955097c32C controls all three pool proxies
Miner-actor FIL (dashboard ww8.sftproject.io dead) is not enumerable and not EVM-reachable
caveats: Lending-pool implementation is unverified; the exact withdraw gate was isolated by storage bisection, not source review
Native FIL at Filecoin miner actors (the protocol's staked FIL) cannot be enumerated (dashboard dead) and is outside FEVM reach; excluded from totals
SFT/rSFT/rSPD have no observable market; values are FIL balances only
H-O figure assumes the 1000 FIL reward reserve is unclaimed staker credits (credit accounting observed); individual claim sizes are small
P figure: lending-pool FIL is reachable by the owner EOA via proxy upgrade/rescue; frozen (S) for everyone else
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0.00 live from SFT Protocol: deposits are paused, all holder withdrawals revert POOL_FIL_BALANCE_NOT_ENOUGH (frozen by internal accounting), borrows require pledges that cannot be created, and farm claims are per-order credits that a fresh staker never earns; ~$1.1K is holder/owner-bound.
